title: SupplementalAttributeAssociation
description: Links a supplemental attribute to the component it describes: one row per (component_id, attribute_id) pair. `component_type` and `attribute_type` are denormalized labels for filtering, not part of the row's identity.

component_id.description: ID of the component the attribute describes.

component_type.description: Type name of the component the attribute describes. A denormalized label for filtering; not part of the row's identity.

attribute_type.description: Schema title of the referenced supplemental attribute (e.g. EmissionsData). Free-form, not an enum: attribute types are added continuously.
